body_ar: العمر الرابع عمر المحشر في الساهرة، ﴿وإن يوما عند ربك كألف سنة مما تعدون﴾ والعمر الخامس وهو الأخير العمر الأبدي السرمدي في جنة أو في نار بالبقاء والخلود فيهما، وهو عمر الجزاء المرتب على عمر العمل، فعمر العمل أقصر الأعمار وعمر الجزاء أطولها، وهذا من فضل الله سبحانه وتعالى ومن تمام عدله،
body_en: The fourth lifespan is the lifespan of the Gathering upon al-sāhirah: {And a day with your Lord is like a thousand years of your counting} (Sūrat al-Ḥajj 22:47). The fifth lifespan — and it is the last — is the everlasting, unending lifespan, in a Garden or in a Fire, abiding and remaining forever in them. It is the lifespan of recompense, which follows upon the lifespan of deeds. The lifespan of deeds is the shortest of the lifespans and the lifespan of recompense the longest; and this is part of the bounty of God, glorified and exalted, and part of the completeness of His justice,

flags.context: The title of the series, appearing in the title of articles 502–516.
options: al-Mughnī al-Mufīd (left untranslated as a work title)
The Sheikh's commentary series on Kitāb al-Tawḥīd
flags.note: Article 516 shows the series expounds Kitāb al-Tawḥīd of Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab, and article 508 quotes the base text in verse, so al-Mughnī al-Mufīd appears to be a versification (naẓm) of that book rather than a separate work by the Sheikh. The Sheikh's office should confirm the work and its author before the title is translated or expanded anywhere in the corpus; it has been left untranslated for now.

flags.context: العمر الرابع عمر المحشر في الساهرة
options: al-sāhirah, the levelled plain on which the dead are gathered
the sleepless place — the ground of the Gathering
flags.note: From Q 79:14, فإذا هم بالساهرة. The exegetes give both 'the surface of the earth' and a proper name for the ground of the Resurrection, and the derivation from sahar ('sleeplessness') is also reported. The Sheikh does not gloss it. The term has been kept in transliteration with a minimal gloss so that no single exegesis is imposed.

translator_notes: The published page carries only the opening excerpt of this lecture/sermon; the Arabic breaks off mid-sentence and the full text is offered on the site as a downloadable Word document. The English ends exactly where the Arabic ends. Nothing has been supplied to complete it.

This page belongs to the Sheikh's tape series on Kitāb al-Tawḥīd of Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab, identified in article 516, the first tape of the series. Passages in quotation marks are the base text being commented on; the unquoted text is the Sheikh's own commentary. The distinction is load-bearing and has been preserved.
Qur'anic renderings in this file are interpretive translations of meaning, offered to carry the Sheikh's argument in English. They are not a substitute for the Arabic text of the Qur'an.
The page opens at 'the fourth lifespan'; the first three are not in the written source. The Sheikh's scheme of five lifespans cannot be reconstructed from this page alone.
